name: The Dunemaul Crate rests on the ground in the Dunemaul Compound (#11612)
contract: #11612 reported the Dunemaul Crate pickup (gameobject entry 515772, guid 6941658) floating at the Dunemaul Compound in Tanaris. It stood 1.22 yd above the terrain at its x/y; it now rests on the ground the server finds under it, so the Dunemaul Warbelt chest opens.

steps.label: SETUP: the pickup is in the area

the pickup is grounded within 0.8 yd
the pickup is not under water
